english.title: Move pig from outside emergency vaccination zone following confirmation of swine vesicular disease (England)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) moved

(A)_[a pig,]_
(B)_[pigs,]_

vaccinated under regulation 31(9)(a) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014, that was outside the emergency vaccination zone, following confirmation of swine vesicular disease, from the premises on which

(C)_[it was]_
(D)_[they were]_

vaccinated, to a place other than a designated slaughterhouse under a licence granted by a licensing inspector
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 31(9)(b) and 39(1A)(q) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: From 29th April 2026, due to changes made by the Exotic Animal Disease (Amendment) (England) Order 2026 (SI 2026/475), this offence applies in England. For the offence applying before this date, see H19876 and for the offence applying in Wales, see H102738.

other.penalty:
Either waySummary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
